🔧 cpp_compile_db
No compile_commands.json found in the workspace (looked in ., build/, out/).

To create one:
- CMake: configure with -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON (e.g. `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON`), then point tools at build/compile_commands.json or copy it to the project root.
- Non-CMake (Make, etc.): wrap the build with Bear, e.g. `bear -- make`.

Or call this tool again with generate=true and it will do whichever of those two applies (the Bear path runs the project's real build, so it needs a trusted project).

A compile database lets clang-tidy, clangd, and sanitizer project builds see the exact compiler flags for every file. Single-file tools still work without it.
